description: Loads a URL (http/https) or a local HTML file path in headless Chrome, runs the A11yScope engine, and returns violations grouped by rule with CSS selectors and HTML snippets. Needs the page to be reachable from this machine.

include_passed.description: Also list rules with zero findings, each with status passed or inapplicable and its checked count.

include_review.description: Also return items that need a human decision (not failures).

max_findings_per_rule.description: Cap on findings returned per rule.

url.description: http(s) URL, file:// URL, or a path to an HTML file (relative to the server's working directory).

wait_ms.description: Extra time to wait after load, for pages that render late.

name: scan_page
title: Scan a page for WCAG 2.2 AA issues
